title: [SOA] Clarify contact mapping options for unknown email senders
summary: The contact-link dialog for unmatched email senders now clearly distinguishes task-level contact overrides from contact data updates, includes the sender's email address, explains that matching uses both Email and Email 2 fields, and explicitly shows E-Mail 2 replacement details.
key_points: Dialog now displays the unmatched sender's email address to help users understand matching failures
Clarifies distinction between task-level contact overrides and updating contact master data
Explains that contact matching checks both Email and Email 2 fields
Shows E-Mail 2 field replacement confirmation with current and replacement values
Low risk change affecting only captions and dialog text with no functional changes
quote: Improve the contact-link dialog shown when an email sender does not match an existing contact.
